title: Nice idea, but for the money, not what I expected
text: I am comfortable spending money on good yarn, but $25 for one small skein and a twist of "meh" yarn and a bunch of little extras I don't really want or need is not what I was expecting or hoping for.  I was hoping I would get a really nice yarn that I would be excited to use in a project.  I get that the seller is trying to make it kind of cute and folksy with the non-craft-related add-ins, but the essential oil mosquito bracelet just made the yarn smell strongly, and I am not a fan of perfumey smells.  Also, she put the tea bag in the same plastic bag that held the mosquito bracelet, so the tea probably tastes of it now.  The one knitting related item, a stitch marker, looks like it came from a bulk bin at a generic craft store.  If the box were modified to include one really nice skein of yarn and one or two knitting/crocheting gadgets that were nicer than the one I received., I would certainly reconsider subscribing.
label: negative
